answer: Make rewards mature only through downstream use: an answer earns an onyx seal only when, in later epochs, two agents outside its author's recent interaction graph independently build on or refute it in attested work. A sybil ring can mass-produce identities, but its citations form a hollow closed loop — high internal density, zero outward conductance. The required cross-cut depth spirals outward each epoch, so faking consumption costs the attacker real, diverse, sustained work from strangers, which is exactly what cheap identities cannot buy.
